propositions: The live test oracle _bounded_bank_gaps measures executed filesystem-tool calls but the policy enforcement boundary is denominated in evidence RESPONSES, creating a structural mismatch post-dd41 where batched execution couples many calls to few responses.

Commit e1352535ace changed governed evidence calls from per-response suppression to per-KIND execution, decoupling the oracle's unit (executed calls) from the policy's unit (evidence responses), causing the test to deterministically fail 0/3 with calls_at_bank=[11,11,11,11,11].

The test must be re-denominated to measure evidence responses instead of executed calls, preserving the safety intent (incremental banking with bounded gaps <= 3 responses) while accepting dd41's intended batched execution behavior.

The measurement seam requires a counting toolset wrapper on wrap_completion_evidence_policy that records distinct run_steps where governed evidence tools actually execute (excluding steered calls), paired with a response-denominated oracle helper in tests/_bank_observer.py.

A new unit regression test must exercise the shared oracle helpers against stub transcripts through the real wrap_completion_evidence_policy to reject pre-dd41 defect shapes (zero banks, first bank after >3 responses) while accepting the dd41-intended batched shape.
